profile.headline: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Senior Embedded Software Engineer concerned with design and development of embedded software for electronic and computer-based equipment. 

Specific interests include software design, development, and testing for real-time systems, communications systems and networked systems.

Specialties: C\C++, Embedded OS's

Experience with Engineering Tools - under Linux, Windows, or Proprietary:
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
GUI: gtk+ 3, gtkmm, Glade Builder, Win32, MFC

IDE: Code::Blocks, Visual Studio C/C++, Microsoft CodeView, Turbo Pascal, Borland C/C++, Turbo Assembler, Microtec Research C, pROBE debugger, XRAY debugger, 

Configuration Management: ClearCase

Languages / Software Engineering : C, C++, Pascal, 80x86/680x0 Assembly Language, 		FORTRAN, BASIC, BASH, Perl, Structured Design and Object-Oriented Design and 		Development.

Operating Systems: Linux (Ubuntu, Linux Mint), Windows, VxWorks, pSOS+, CMX RTOS, UNIX, VAX/VMS -

Network Protocols: TCP/IP, Novell Netware, NETBIOS

Device Drivers: Linux, Windows NT

Instruments: Oscilloscopes, Logic Analyzers, Spectrum Analyzers, Protocol	Analyzers

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.insights: Skills: Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP) · C (Programming Language) · Software Development · Software Design

positions.title: principal software engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer developing object-oriented embedded code written in C++ running under Green Hills OS and VxWorks.

Software Engineer for a projectile program.Code is written in C/C++ and Ada running under Integrity OS.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on various software aspects of the MUOS UE Waveform. The UE Waveform is a software defined radio application for a mobile platform. Most of the code is in C with some C++. Specific Tasks including:
	•	Worked on Program Change Requests (PCRs) for the Transport Layer.
	•	Debugged various issues of ported code on the target.
	•	Merged different version of the source code.
	•	Developed a Windows GUI (Win32) Application to capture Debug data being sent by the Target via Ethernet using TCP/IP. This Application would capture the data stream from several targets simultaneously and Display and log the debug data (in a text file) per target for later analysis.

positions.title: software engineering consultant
positions.description:
Tasks include porting and debugging embedded communications software under VxWorks for a dual processore MPC860 PowerQUICC and MC68360 QUICC communications module. This communications module (TCM) added communication resources to the 3 Main Processors (MP’s). These resources included 2 Ethernet LAN’s, 3 Serial Channels (configurable as Modbus Slaves or Masters), and a debug port.  The TCM communicated with the 3 MP’s thru dedicated HDLC links.  This application is written in C using the VxWorks development environment.  

Specific tasks in porting and debugging this application:
	• 	Enhance and Debug ISR’s.
	• 	Test and Verify and Debug various proprietary communications protocols.
	•	Port and Debug I2C driver routines.
	• 	Port and Debug on-line Diagnostic tests.

positions.title: software engineering consultant
positions.description:
Tasks include design and development of a Windows XP and Windows CE software application for a proprietary messaging protocol using tcp/ip sockets. This application is written in C using Microsoft’s Visual C++ 2005 development environment. The Application will be ported to an embedded Linux environment. 

Specific tasks in developing this application:
	• 	Derived and Documented Application Architecture and software module’s specification.
	• 	Designed modules and API’s.
	•	Developed modules and performed unit and integration testing.
	• 	Developed a Windows-based (using MFC) test program to perform unit and integration testing of all modules.
